findings.title: Skill capability contracts not enforceable from frontmatter
findings.observedBehavior: Only name/description used; allowed-tools ignored; session policy still gates tools; frontmatter cannot expand authority
findings.expectedBehaviorPriorHypothesis: Per-skill permissions missing and possibly unsafe
findings.exploitability: Skill can instruct model to call any tool; exploitation requires session-permissive mode and model compliance — not a silent auth bypass
findings.preconditions: Skill installed in trusted discovery path; session allows the suggested tool
findings.uncertainty: Mapping of external Agent Skills allowed-tools dialects not implemented

findings.title: No durable skill execution identity on tool receipts
findings.observedBehavior: Activation is tool output text; receipts lack skillName/digest/activationId
findings.expectedBehaviorPriorHypothesis: Downstream tools unbound to skill identity
findings.exploitability: Forensic gap; not direct privilege escalation

findings.title: Skill content not cryptographically pinned to activation
findings.observedBehavior: No digest; in-memory sticky until refresh; symlink retarget changes content after refresh
findings.expectedBehaviorPriorHypothesis: TOCTOU between activate and later use
findings.exploitability: Operator or concurrent process can change skill files mid-session; attribution ambiguity
findings.preconditions: Write access to skill path or symlink target
findings.uncertainty: Watcher timing races not exhaustively timed
regressionRequirements: activation digest stable; live mode detects drift

findings.title: Global install location establishes trust without publisher validation
findings.observedBehavior: Global dirs always trusted; workspace gated; symlinks followed; outside target via global link trusted; bodies unsanitized on activate
findings.exploitability: Hostile skill in global dir influences model under session policy
findings.preconditions: Ability to write global skill dir or replace symlink target

findings.title: No integrated skill qualification/revocation lifecycle
findings.observedBehavior: Watcher refresh only; delete sticky until refresh; CERI/regression exist but unused for skills
findings.exploitability: Operational; revoked content may remain in context
findings.uncertainty: Best reuse shape for CERI vs lightweight index
regressionRequirements: revoke blocks activate and attributed tools

findings.title: ApprovalPolicy isUntrustedSource unused on live dispatch path
findings.observedBehavior: isUntrustedSource never set in policyContext; untrusted workspace skills hard-denied earlier
findings.expectedBehavior: Either wire gating or remove dead API
findings.exploitability: Design confusion; compensating hard-deny for untrusted workspace skills
findings.preconditions: None for bypass of workspace untrusted deny
regressionRequirements: document or enforce context_inject untrusted gating

findings.title: Shell confinement does not parse command filesystem operands
findings.observedBehavior: command string treated as opaque resource; fullAccess skips confinement; RO allowlists help
findings.expectedBehavior: Known session model; skills amplify instructional risk only
findings.exploitability: Under auto/fullAccess, shell can effect outside path jail
findings.uncertainty: Sandbox re-qualification not in this audit
regressionRequirements: skill constraints can deny run_command; sandbox docs remain accurate
findings.notes: Not a skills-only defect; included because skills commonly instruct shell

findings.title: Skill FS watcher watches fewer directories than discovery loads
findings.observedBehavior: Watcher omits .claude/skills and several config skill roots that refresh() still loads
findings.expectedBehavior: Watcher set should match discovery roots or document intentional lag
findings.exploitability: Stale catalog until restart/explicit refresh; not an authority bypass
findings.preconditions: Skill installed only under an unwatched root; REPL watcher running
compensatingControls: activate_skill still reads via getSkill after refresh
regressionRequirements: watcher dirs ⊇ discovery dirs or documented exceptions with test
